## Definition
The physical or chemical interactions (e.g., covalent bonding, adsorption, entrapment) that anchor enzymes to a carrier, protecting them from denaturation and enabling repeated use. Mirrors the need for stable, reconfigurable connections in TCC topologies, where link reliability and fault tolerance are critical for long-term network operation.
